name: The Complete Guide to Using Claude Code 📘
description_md:
## What You Get

- Almost 300-page Claude Code Complete Guide PDF, a searchable reference with examples, templates, and runnable scripts you can keep for continued learning.

- A plain-English introduction that explains what Claude Code is and why it could matter to builders and curious non-technical people.

- Step-by-step setup and core command lessons so you can install and run Claude Code with confidence.

- Small, copyable examples for building, debugging, and simple automation that you can try immediately.

- Practical patterns for sub-agents and basic tool integrations that work at a modest scale.

- Short, pragmatic notes on software building principles to help you move from consuming tools to making them.
